name: starlight-aurora
description: Aurora, the Colliery design system, as an Astro Starlight theme

scripts.demo:check: node scripts/check-build.mjs demo/dist && node scripts/check-site.mjs demo/dist
scripts.demo:build:hyper: cd demo && AURORA_HYPER=1 npx astro build --outDir dist-hyper
scripts.demo:check:hyper: node scripts/check-build.mjs demo/dist-hyper && node scripts/check-site.mjs demo/dist-hyper --hyper
